best: The newsletter pitch: 132 words, it discloses the April 2026 cloud sunset as the rule requires, uses one sourced proof point (37,532 stars), and invents no story. Its one error is naming WhatsApp, which needs the defunct cloud.
worst: The launch premise itself. Brand, social and commercial all build on an invented reason for the cloud sunset ('because personal AI must be open-source') and a pricing plan that relaunches a hosted cloud. The founders' own notice says they shut the cloud down because a subscription, cloud-first service was hard to sustain, and that they now focus on Open Paper and Pipali. Two of eight stages (targets, signals) produced nothing, and the Show HN draft for the chosen angle is missing.
notes: Three pipeline runs failed or never finished: show_hn (error, 664s), targets (error, 1366s) and signals (still running), yet summary.json reports every stage ok and 'drafted': true for Hacker News; the drive's ok signal is unreliable. Facts checked live on 2026-09-29: app.khoj.dev sunset notice (the reasons, the April 2021 origin, the new focus on Open Paper and Pipali); khoj.dev products list; repo README (WhatsApp and app.khoj.dev still listed); src/khoj/utils/constants.py telemetry_server and documentation/docs/get-started/privacy-security.md (PostHog telemetry on by default); documentation/docs/clients/whatsapp.md (needs a Khoj Cloud account). The revenue maths is internally consistent (option 1 assumes an unstated 50/50 split of the $15 and $49 tiers: 10 x 32 = 320). No em dashes and no banned s-h-i-p verbs appear in output; the only 'SHIP' is an unused template default ('FOR TEAMS WHO SHIP') in the reel spec's lock_top slot.
